behavior: Codex and Claude use one asynchronous account verification and recovery lifecycle for new/resume/handoff launches.
Account labels are arbitrary display labels, not routing or identity selectors. Existing Codex bindings remain backward-compatible; Claude bindings are optional and separate.
Healthy matching identity continues without forcing another browser login. Missing credentials and mismatches offer native login to the exact selected home or explicit fresh-read confirmation.
Native login does not run logout first. Success requires another fresh identity check before the original conversation can start once; failure or cancellation cannot authorize it.
The original command, cwd, label, handoff input and queued synchronization are preserved. Focused matching held project takes priority over deterministic held fallback and standalone scope.

Claude status is cached configuration metadata, not proof of a working token. A required authenticated profile response establishes live identity; metadata disagreement and unknown response shapes fail closed.

Claude inherited native vault differs from an explicit config override even at the same path. Account launch, native status, login and profile probes retain the selected namespace and project context.

Ambient OAuth refresh credentials, scopes, custom headers, API keys, gateway URLs and provider overrides are cleared. Authentication settings overrides are refused rather than weakening managed login policies.
Saved binding badges say identity bound, not currently verified. Stale results cannot authorize work or redirect unrelated account edits/focus.
simplifications: Generalized the existing Codex lifecycle instead of adding a parallel Claude state machine.
Centralized recovery cwd selection for inspection and native login.
Removed the redundant scope-wide post-login check; verify each exact held command directly.
Reused account launch environments for provider probes and native conversation/login commands.

verification.fixtures: Synthetic CLI/profile/Keychain-stub PTYs in task-owned temporary homes; no real inference, browser OAuth or account switching. Real account-isolation integration tests inspect native status only.

code_spec_security.confirmed: Fresh post-login checks, selected home/cwd, refreshed confirmation and ambient credential/header clearing

architecture.watch: Invalidating a probe discards its result but does not cancel its detached worker. Claude subprocess work is bounded by a shared eight-second deadline; harmful credential races were not demonstrated. Namespace cancellation/serialization is a follow-up.

installation.replacement: Atomic same-directory rename after workspace tests passed

sanitization.historical_evidence: Original timestamps, checksums and verification caveats retained; anonymized historical records do not attest to current edited bytes.
sanitization.edited_html_fixture_checks: 1440/969/390 viewport checks passed; zero runtime errors or external requests

changed_files_this_extension: 19 existing examples/docs/test files in the sanitization manifest
remaining_risks_and_gaps: No successful real Claude authenticated profile or actual browser login/account restoration was performed. Synthetic responses prove lifecycle behavior, not restoration of the user's intended account.
Claude profile URL and shape follow installed Claude Code 2.1.302 source, not a guaranteed public API. Future incompatible contracts fail closed and require adaptation.
Explicit Claude config paths needing Unicode NFC normalization are refused by the macOS vault hasher rather than risking selection of a wrong vault.
Detached stale probes are bounded but not actively cancelled; see architecture WATCH.
Running panes are not restarted or silently reauthenticated. Default provider homes remain shared with other native applications.
Desktop sources were unchanged and the desktop application was neither built nor installed. Shared core is also consumed by desktop discovery.
